2608.05332.title: Hierarchical Server Architecture for Agentic Science
2608.05332.paper_summary: Agentic science is transforming the landscape of computational work, extending to scientific pipelines and workload managers. The workloads require specialized hardware within and across institutions. If assessing workload needs against environments is required for scheduling, automated discovery of resources is an essential step. In this paper, we present a hierarchical, dynamic architecture and software to discover resources across diverse cloud, edge, and HPC systems. The design enables concurrent, asynchronous negotiation, selection, and dispatch of requests for work using secretary agents. The agents probe and discover 51 real and simulated providers across 7 categories. We perform 19,973 negotiation and 6,952 selection simulations to assess reliability of decisions, demonstrating high (87.71\%) negotiation accuracy and selection costs comparable to more traditional strategies. Designed for extensibility and currently supporting the Genesis Mission, this architecture exemplifies the importance of careful coordination between agents, discovery tools, and infrastructure for agentic science.
2608.05332.paper_summary_zh: 代理科學正在改變計算工作的格局，延伸至科學流程和工作負載管理器。這些工作負載需要跨機構的專用硬體。如果需要根據環境評估工作負載需求以進行排程，自動資源發現是一個必要步驟。在本文中，我們提出了一種層次化的動態架構和軟體，以發現跨越多樣化雲端、邊緣和高效能計算系統的資源。該設計使得使用秘書代理進行請求的工作可以同時、非同步地進行協商、選擇和派遣。這些代理探測並發現了7個類別中的51個真實和模擬提供者。我們進行了19,973次協商和6,952次選擇模擬，以評估決策的可靠性，顯示出高達87.71\%的協商準確率和與更傳統策略可比擬的選擇成本。這一架構設計為可擴展性，並且目前支持創世任務，體現了代理科學中代理、發現工具和基礎設施之間仔細協調的重要性。
2608.05332.author: Vanessa Sochat et.al.
